_comment: Default bindings for the controller this package declares. Chimera ships
no bindings of its own - a package that declares a controller says how
it is played by default, and the frontend uses that for a controller
the user's config has never seen. Key names are what Chimera sends:
letters as-is, digits as Number0-Number9, Space, Enter, Shift (merged:
a default setup sends Shift for either Shift key). Gamepad/joystick
names take the form X1 A (Xbox pad), J1 B1 (plain joystick).
Unbound buttons stay unbound: only the Kempston-on-arrows preset, the
QAOP letters and the 1:1 keyboard are bound here; the Sinclair and
Cursor presets are picked in the controller config.
Both Shift keys send Shift, so Caps Shift and Symbol Shift both answer
it (either physical Shift holds both - rebind them separately to split).
